Overview

A web platform and associated R package for metabolomics data processing, statistical analysis, visualization, functional interpretation, and multi-omics integration.

Detailed capability map

What can this tool do?

Univariate statisticsMultivariate statisticsFeature selectionPathway enrichmentInteractive dashboard

Common uses

  • Perform exploratory and inferential statistics on metabolomics data tables.
  • Generate visualizations and pathway-level interpretations.
  • Integrate metabolomics with transcriptomics or other omics results.

Scientific fit

Primary function

Statistical analysis

Other functions

Normalization and batch correction, Visualization and reporting, Pathway and biological interpretation, Multi-omics integration, Preprocessing and feature extraction

Analysis types

Targeted metabolomics, Untargeted metabolomics, Metabolite profiling, Lipidomics, Multi-omics

Data compatibility

Inputs

Feature or peak table, Compound list or annotations, Sample metadata, Statistical results

Outputs

Statistical results, Pathway or reaction data, Human-readable report

Input formats

CSV or TSV

Output formats

CSV or TSV, PNG, PDF, SVG
